notes.title: + 489 vfx
notes.content:
I have made by your requests:

+ 465 vfx spells:
• 76 Spells (12 Ice, 12 Fire, 11 Arcane, 10 Storm, 11 Light, 10 Dark, 10 Nature).
• 7 Auras (One for each type of magic).
• 7 Shields (One for each type of magic).
• 7 Buffs (One for each type of magic).
• 7 Tomes (One for each type of magic).
• 20 Casting Effects (3 Ice, 4 Fire, 3 Arcane, 2 Storm, 2 Light, 4 Dark, 2 Nature).
• 20 Projectiles (3 Ice, 4 Fire, 3 Arcane, 2 Storm, 2 Light, 4 Dark, 2 Nature).
• 20 Explosions (3 Ice, 4 Fire, 3 Arcane, 2 Storm, 2 Light, 4 Dark, 2 Nature).
• 301 Color Variations.

notes.title: More emotions
notes.content:
I have made by your requests:

+ Fix of unexpected vRoid rotation
+ Fix of Gabriel tool color
+ Directional light rotation
+ Rebuild of eye and look animator, face muscles and look at:
Simulating eyes' point of interest lag for more realism.
Random eyes movement simulation, with different presets: From calm through nervous to psychical cues - movement of eyes when someone is lying / trying to remember sound etc.
Eyelids blinking animation
Face muscles movement when character speak.
Improved lips reaction when character speak. (Now, jaw is no mowing. I will fix it in the near future)
Shoulders and neck rotation when character follow camera or other character.
